For my beans plot, I will use the manure from my goats and chickens to make the soil strong, because I do not have money to buy the chemical fertilizers from the shop. I will plant the same seeds I have saved from last season, and I will rely on my children and grandchildren to help me with the planting, weeding, and harvesting. I do not have money for pesticides or to hire workers, and the rains in Mbeya have always been enough for my beans without irrigation.
